expiry_source: original persisted activity and child leases plus pending cancellation timer
contract: The new native revision follows the published PHP ordinary five-minute activity lease. Recovery waits for the already committed original lease, with this bound declared before preparing a new cohort. The previous sub-forty-second native recovery observations and failures remain unchanged. No current run receives a replacement lease or deadline to fit the test. This wait allocation does not claim performance or modify workflow execution budgets.
